name: TOTP Sign-In Could Not Authenticate
summary: An identified returning user submits a TOTP code that is not accepted; no authenticated session is created and the client presents a dedicated error surface with Try Again and Start Over actions.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active durable identity with confirmed email and enrolled TOTP is prepared for sign-in

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Prepared test-user email resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

inputs.name: Verification Code
inputs.description: Deliberately invalid current TOTP proof generated by deterministic test setup for the enrolled authenticator.

serverInteraction.intent: Resolve the existing durable identity, reject the submitted TOTP proof without establishing a session, and return the canonical rejected TOTP sign-in outcome.

postconditions.expression: the durable identity remains active with TOTP enabled, no successful login is recorded, no authenticated session is established, and the dedicated unable-to-authenticate view is visible

sourceReferences.note: Both browser-session and mobile-token TOTP entry points return the canonical rejected result without establishing authenticated state.
Typed handler delegates invalid proof to the real MFA manager and emits auth.transition.totp-sign-in.rejected.
Real-path integration proof verifies invalid TOTP rejection and proves the sign-in adapter is not invoked.
Dedicated public failure surface provides Try Again and Start Over without disclosing internal rejection details.
Angular routes unsuccessful createTotpLogin results to the canonical unable view.
React Native routes rejected token authentication to the canonical unable view.
